mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_ledger(product_id, biz_type, qty_change, before_qty, after_qty, ref_type, ref_id, operator, remark, created_at) VALUES (#{productId}, #{bizType}, #{qtyChange}, #{beforeQty}, #{afterQty}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{operator}, #{remark}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT l.*, p.name AS product_name FROM product_ledger l JOIN product p ON p.id = l.product_id WHERE l.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY l.id DESC
